script:
Wei Xiaodi
Your name is Wei Xiaodi, born into a warm family. Your father was a musical genius, and you inherited his musical talent, passing piano level 10 in elementary school. But now your father runs a small newsstand, struggling to make ends meet. When you ask why he didn't pursue music, he always just smiles without saying anything.
In your memory, your parents would talk in their room from time to time, and you could occasionally hear phrases like "give up" and "if not for him, how could we possibly live so difficultly." Sometimes when you accidentally opened your father's bag, you could see some law firm business cards. You really wanted to know the story behind it, but whenever you asked your parents, they never answered.
In 2010, your father became seriously ill, smiling less and less each day, becoming increasingly melancholy. Your mother also seemed troubled. You really wanted to help them solve their problems but couldn't do anything.
In August 2015, your father passed away, leaving behind many belongings to sort through. On top of his bedroom closet was a box you'd never seen before. Opening it, you found a handwritten sheet music manuscript in your father's handwriting, signed by your father, dated November 28, 1995.
You were very familiar with this sheet music. In 1996, an unknown person released an original piano piece that shocked the music world - this person was Qin Zhuanjia. You loved this piece very much and knew its sheet music by heart.
Seeing all this, you seemed to understand everything. To confirm the truth, you took the manuscript to your mother and asked her to clarify the whole story. Yes, the person who stole your father's original work, suppressed and threatened your family everywhere, and caused your father to die in melancholy was Qin Zhuanjia. You secretly swore to avenge the Wei family and seek justice for your father.
On September 1, 2015, you came to Qingbei High School. In your class, someone named Qin Laoda caught your attention because he only slept through every class, was usually very arrogant, and besides one lackey-like follower, seemed to have many fair-weather friends.
During a break, you heard people discussing Qin Laoda, saying he was the son of famous musician Qin Zhuanjia. You shuddered - you were actually in the same class as your enemy's son. You wanted to immediately rush over and strangle Qin Laoda, but thinking about how your family had been suppressed by Qin Zhuanjia for so many years, you couldn't let Qin Laoda die so easily. Calming down, you decided to endure humiliation for a while - a gentleman's revenge is never too late, even after ten years.
You began intentionally or unintentionally approaching Qin Laoda, gradually gaining his favor and becoming his second lackey. You appeared clever and smooth in handling affairs. He trusted you greatly, telling you everything, and you worked hard to collect his weaknesses, seeking opportunities for revenge.
In September 2016, you followed Qin Laoda in choosing liberal arts and together entered Grade 11 Class 7. There were new teachers - PE teacher Xiao Tiyu and music teacher Xue Meiniang. You knew they were the school's model couple but didn't care. A girl named Zhuang Qingchun in class caught your attention - you found her pure, elegant, and a good piano player. But focused on revenge, you didn't express much interest, only knowing she had a good relationship with classmate Jia Meili.
On the evening of October 26, 2016, after evening study session, your group went out for late-night snacks. Passing a certain alley corner, you heard some commotion inside. Qin Laoda walked over, and you followed, discovering some classmates bullying another student. Qin Laoda made them release that student, and they didn't dare resist due to his prestige. You knew he didn't do this out of justice but to enjoy the feeling of everyone's submission.
The rescued person was Zheng Youhao, an academically excellent but quiet classmate. From then on, Zheng Youhao began having some interaction with your three-person group, gradually helping you run errands and buy things, even helping with homework. Qin Laoda told you more than once that he found this dog really useful. You pitied Zheng Youhao because you knew Qin Laoda wasn't a good person, so when Qin Laoda insulted him, you tried not to join in when you could avoid it.
During a break in evening study session in March 2018, Qin Laoda called Zheng Youhao as usual to buy late-night snacks for everyone. Zheng Youhao said he needed to go to the office to submit homework and wanted Qin Laoda to help bring snacks.
Qin Laoda was obviously stunned and laughed: "I'm about to go to the toilet to take a shit. Want me to bring it back for you to eat?" After saying this, his other lackey laughed heartily while you remained silent.
For so long, you'd had enough of Qin Laoda's arrogance and crude language. With college entrance exams approaching and everyone about to go separate ways, you felt the time to act was near.
June 1, 2018 was the last Friday before the college entrance exam. All graduating students would go home to rest and prepare for the exam after this day. That evening, your Grade 12 Class 7 classmates would have a farewell dinner at a restaurant near school. You planned to act after the dinner.
19:00, the farewell dinner began on time. During the meal, Jia Meili, who usually had no interaction with Qin Laoda, was particularly attentive to him and even toasted him.
21:00, everyone finished eating and prepared to go home. You noticed Qin Laoda seemed a bit listless, thinking he was drunk. Qin Laoda said he needed to return to the dormitory to get some luggage. You said you'd also left something in the dormitory and left the restaurant together with him.
21:15, you and Qin Laoda each returned to your dormitories. You found the fruit knife you'd prepared long ago and entered Qin Laoda's dormitory. As soon as you entered, you saw Qin Laoda crouching on the ground with a pale face. You walked up pretending to show concern, then when he wasn't paying attention, you stabbed him hard in the abdomen. Qin Laoda didn't resist and instantly fell to the ground.
21:18, you looked at Qin Laoda still struggling on the ground and left his dormitory.
21:20, you left hastily with luggage you'd packed long ago. When walking out of the dormitory building, a male student in black clothes brushed past you, but you didn't pay attention.
22:00, having returned home, you received a police summons.
